title: Symmetry-Protected Basin Localization in Variational Quantum Eigensolvers
summary: Variational quantum eigensolvers fail before optimization begins when strong correlation splits the molecular energy landscape into competing basins and the initial state selects a non-ground-state basin. We introduce a geometry-conditioned preconditioner $\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{eq}}:\mathbf{R}\mapsto\boldsymbolθ_0$ constrained by the $SE(3)$ covariance of the molecular Hamiltonian, so that nuclear geometry is mapped directly into circuit parameters in the correlated ground-state basin. This basin localization changes the relevant gradient statistics from concentration controlled to curvature…
